fieldData.excerpt: There have been many exciting developments this year for Radix.
fieldData.main-content:
There have been many exciting developments this year for Radix. Our team and community have grown considerably, and we hosted our first-ever Hackathon, which was a resounding success.

Join us as we take a look back at some of our highlights and major achievements of this year.

Make sure you keep up to date with all the latest news from Radix and follow our journey to build the first Layer 1 protocol specifically built for DeFi just click here. And once you have caught up, why not join the conversation in our lively community Telegram group?
fieldData.seo-meta-description: The year 2018 from the Radix perspective - an overview of our achievements, including a testnet, our very first hackathon and the growth of our community.
fieldData.name: 2018 Year in Review
